verdicts.rationale: Survivor and hobbsstickelappeltmartin1993interpretation and e1993interpretation are all the 1993 Artificial Intelligence journal article (vol 63, pp 69-142, DOI 10.1016/0004-3702(93)90015-4) — merge OK. But hobbs1988interpretation and hobbs1990interpretation are the SEPARATE 1988 ACL conference paper 'Interpretation as Abduction' (Proc. 26th ACL, pp 95-103, DOI 10.3115/982023.982035) — a distinct, shorter publication. hobbs1988interpretation is deepIndexed (real work) and must not be archived into the journal article.

All three are Holroyd 'VIII—What Do We Want from a Model of Implicit Cognition?', Proc. Aristotelian Society vol 116(2), pp 153-179, same DOI 10.1093/arisoc/aow005. Only citekey/type/author-format differences; only the survivor is indexed. True duplicates.

Both are Hong et al. 'Explicit information for category-orthogonal object properties...', Nature Neuroscience 19(4), pp 613-622, same DOI 10.1038/nn.4247. Only author-format/citekey differences. Loser not indexed. True duplicate.

Both are Horn & Ward's Handbook of Pragmatics, same DOI 10.1075/hop.13 and identical note (867 pp.). Year/publisher differ (2023 Wiley-Blackwell vs 2009 John Benjamins) but the shared DOI and title identify the same edited handbook. Only the survivor is indexed; loser not indexed. Merge OK.

Both are Horgan 'Jackson on Physical Information and Qualia', Philosophical Quarterly 34(135), p 147, same DOI 10.2307/2219508, identical fields. The survivor citekey is a JSTOR-URL-style shadow key; horgan1984jackson is the hand key. Both deepIndexed but genuinely the same article — merge OK (consolidates into survivor).
Both are Huff & Schwan 'Do not cross the line...', Psychonomic Bulletin & Review 19(6), pp 1065-1072, same DOI. Only author-format/citekey differences. Loser not indexed. True duplicate.

Both are Huffman 'Impossible Objects as Nonsense Sentences', Machine Intelligence vol 6. Years differ (1977 vs 1971) and one is incollection vs article, but same title/author/venue/volume identify the same work (a known chapter with variable citation dates). Both deepIndexed but the same work — merge into survivor.

All members are Gombrich's Art and Illusion, but two members are independently deepIndexed and represent substantively different editions: survivor illusion1960pictoria (2000 Princeton reprint, ISBN 0691070008) and gombrich1960art (the original 1960 Bollingen/Pantheon edition with Mellon-Lectures note, ISBN 9780714815503). Two-or-more independently indexed distinct editions — keep gombrich1960art separate. The non-indexed variants (gombrich1961art '2nd', Gom56, gombrich1960) are shadow/edition stubs that fold into the survivor.

Both are Ippolito 'Quantification over Times in Subjunctive Conditionals', SALT, p 127, same DOI 10.3765/salt.v0i0.2889, identical note. Only author-format/journal-field differences. Loser not indexed. True duplicate.

Both are Isaac 'Digital Images: Content and Compositionality', J. American Philosophical Association 3(1), pp 106-126, same DOI 10.1017/apa.2017.13. Only author-format/citekey differences. Loser not indexed. True duplicate.

All four are Shea 'VI-Exploitable Isomorphism and Structural Representation', Proc. Aristotelian Society 114(2pt2), pp 123-144, same DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9264.2014.00367.x. shea2014exploitable is 'indexed' (real work) but genuinely the same article as survivor — duplicate import under different citekeys. Merge OK; consolidates into survivor.

Both are Lumsden 'Genes, mind, and culture' (1981, Harvard University Press, ISBN 9780674344754), identical fields. Only citekey differs (j-prefixed shadow vs hand key). Neither indexed. True duplicate.
